params.val: reflects a stat-lowering effect back at whoever caused it, instead of applying it to the holder

the stat change is not a decrease, or was self-inflicted, OR this exact effect has already been reflected once by a Mirror Armor holder (no infinite bounce between two Mirror Armor holders), OR the target's affected stat is already at -6 (the drop is left to apply normally to the holder instead of being reflected), OR the attacker has already fainted by the time the reflection would happen
